value.rationale: The fixed-s continuous Gumbel approximation is structurally invalid when each round samples a positive fraction of the population; in that regime terminal fluctuations occur over O(1) integer rounds. Identifying the complete discrete law and order-one phase corrections, for all fixed repeated-coverage thresholds, closes a motivated asymptotic gap important for batch/multicoverage sampling.
